verdict.rationale: The GitHub README documents terminal commands that run agents without the web UI: `adk run path/to/my_agent`, plus `adk eval` against bundled samples (samples_for_testing/hello_world, contributing/samples/evaluation/home_automation_agent) with evalset files. An agent could use these to run example agents and check behavior from the shell, and the docs also promote Agents CLI for scaffold/build/test/evaluate in AI-enabled environments. missing for 10: explicit documentation that `adk run` works non-interactively or scriptably (single-prompt or piped input), machine-readable output and exit-code semantics for automated verification, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless use.
